Also use for clarification-first requests, factual queries with material gaps, project planning, recommendations, don't-know replies, and ordinary continuations. When material prerequisites are missing, ask every independent material question together in one short numbered list; explain options as needed and restate pending questions after an explanation; answer settled, complete, explicitly delegated, and supported advice-only requests directly.
